_комментарий: Blind-run policy: runtime prompts must not receive known violation examples during validation.
Ground truth and historical examples are intentionally kept outside the runtime path.
Evaluation is performed only after a run has completed, by an external evaluator.
Do not add benchmark cases, room numbers, expected findings, or benchmark-derived hints here.
If historical examples are used later in production, keep them in a separate production-only source that is never mounted for blind validation.
